Subject: Transfer: assurance pack and legal artifacts for GCP co-sell listing

Hi Paula / Marketplace team,

Following up from our partner intake call last week — Acme's co-sell onboarding team asked us to upload the security and legal package for the GCP catalog listing and to provide signed copies for your review. Please find the items we'd like to transfer to your intake bucket:

- Redwood SOC 2 Type II report (May 2026)
- Third-party penetration test attestation (summary letter)
- Signed DPA (customer-facing template)

Quick asks:
1) Which exact file naming convention do you prefer for the catalog (we can rename files to match your ingest rules)?
2) Do you need notarized or scanned wet-signatures for the DPA, or is DocuSign acceptable?
3) ETA you'd like these by for the co-sell readiness checklist? We are targeting the marketplace approval window the week of Jan 4.

I've attached the PDFs here and shared a Drive folder link below. If legal needs additional metadata (e.g., SOC2 scope mapping for GCP integrations), we can produce a short mapping memo.

Thanks — looking to coordinate timelines so our engineering team can finalize the listing assets.

Best,
Irene Choi
Director, Partnerships (Americas)
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Report_2026-05.pdf (PDF, 48MB); PenTest_Attestation_2026.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB); Redwood_DPA_signed.pdf (PDF, 320KB)

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRedwood-Marketplace-Pack
From: marketplace-support@acmecloud.com
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Paula White <paula.white@acmecloud.com>, onboarding-legal@acmecloud.com
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 10:33:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Transfer: assurance pack and legal artifacts for GCP co-sell listing

Hi Irene — thanks for the packet and the link. A few things from our intake checklist: 

- File naming: we ask partners to use this pattern: <vendor>_<artifact>_<YYYY-MM>.pdf (e.g., redwood_soc2_2026-05.pdf). Please use lower-case and underscores.
- DPA: DocuSign is accepted; onboarding-legal needs the signed PDF export from DocuSign. No notarization required.
- Pen test: summary letter + attestation that remediation was applied to any critical findings is preferred. The attestation can be a short memo.
- SOC2: please include a one-page scope summary that maps GCP integrations (service accounts, BigQuery, Cloud Storage) to in-scope controls.

We have started a secure intake folder on our side — you can upload to the Drive link you already provided and then post the final file list here so legal can pull them into Acme's compliance repository.

Target timeline: if you can upload finalized files by Friday 12/18 EOD PT, our legal and security teams will aim to complete documentation review by 12/22. That keeps us on track for the Jan 4 listing window.

Paula White
Partner Onboarding Manager
Acme Cloud Solutions

Checklist link: https://acmecloud.onboarding/checklist/partner-security-intake

I'll draft the one-page SOC2->GCP mapping and upload to the shared folder. Planning to finalize uploads by 12/18 per Acme's timeline.

Sergio
